words: Lever change, measured: the species appearance includes 'Shaggy fur' and the approved sheet's outline is tufty all over, which texture fur cannot give. Nick's iPhone held 59 fps at every tested preset including 15K-triangle creatures and 24 creatures at 10K, so the full-tier cap for creatures whose appearance includes shaggy or feathered fur rises from 12,000 to 15,000 triangles, the extra spent only on alpha-tested fringe cards. Alpha overdraw of the cards is unmeasured and gets measured on Nick's phone at stage 10; if it costs frames the card count comes down.
